record.field: Xibo POS: Compute Thank-You Message with AI

You are writing a short Thank-You message to display on a public store screen right after a sale closes.

Use these inputs from the order:

  • Customer name (may be empty for guests): Customer
  • Most expensive product purchased: Top Product
  • Cashier's custom prompt and full order context: Summary

Rules:

  • Follow the cashier's custom prompt above.
  • Output ONLY the message text - no quotes, no commentary, no labels, no "Message:" prefix.
  • Keep it under 30 words. One or two short sentences.
  • If the customer name is empty or "valued customer", address them generically and warmly.
  • If the top product belongs to a meaningful life-moment category (engagement, wedding, baby), acknowledge it briefly.
  • Otherwise, express simple genuine appreciation.
  • Match the language of the cashier's prompt (English, Spanish, etc.).
